title: One BRAN state, many uses
legend:
**Extended Data Fig. 1 | One BRAN state, many uses, each beside its strongest comparator.**
**a**, Lines give BRAN, the strongest or prespecified primary comparator, and BRAN minus comparator with its paired 95% interval on an axis symmetric about zero (half-range at right, right favours BRAN). Intervals are from participant, admission or survey-cluster bootstrap, or the survey design for NHANES models. BRAN tied in 12 and trailed in 9 of 21 comparisons with the strongest comparator and led in none. Retrieval led raw CCA only before age adjustment (Fig. 2a). On the official test the development referral gain did not replicate. Hazard ratios (HR) and betas are per SD, except top-fifth and cluster lines (members against non-members), and beside terms come from joint models. A retinal-route retrain changed eye-alone AUROC by −0.0051 [−0.0089, −0.0015] and was not adopted. KNHANES 2022 to 2023 raw analogs lay further from zero than BRAN distance for visual acuity and phase angle (Source Data). Retained-model retrieval, the NHANES outcome-trained flexible ceiling and Phenotypic Age in 1999 to 2004 are PLACEHOLDER. † Earlier checkpoint. CCA, canonical correlation analysis. pp, percentage points. Counts given as at least are rounded down to 20, other counts are exact.
**b**, The predecessor model on the official test (352 people), normalized loss by arm (left), single arm minus paired (middle) and by target without intervals (right). Intervals are 95% from 2,000 patient-cluster bootstrap draws, and P values are one-sided and Holm-adjusted. Paired input was not shown better than the blood arm (P = 0.055), so the predecessor model's primary end point was not met. MoCA, Montreal Cognitive Assessment. MLCS, PLCS, VIA M and VIA P, AI-READI visual function scores.
methods_notes: Methods notes for Extended Data Fig. 1 (moved from the legend). Internal rows pool the five development-fold models of AI-READI. Elsewhere the fold 0 model scored MIMIC-IV, INSPIRE and KNHANES, and the red-cell direction and distance from health were learned on fold 0 states and applied in NHANES. Primary marks a prespecified single comparator or the comparator with the best point estimate inside a prespecified family. The native-head primary family of five had one-sided Bonferroni bounds above zero for every comparator in development. Tuned-probe bound against VisionFM with clinical values +0.0171. Eye alone, the BRAN retinal state also trailed its own 384 input features in the four eye conditions, −0.0179 [−0.0327, −0.0026]. Haemoglobin rows use the complete blood count cohort (at least 1,880 people). Undiagnosed hypertension compares at least 400 undiagnosed positives with 540 negatives. The official test admitted 24 of 26 conditions, had at least 20 people below 12 g/dL, and its red-cell coupling had permutation p 0.0001. It was scored once with the R7 checkpoint, the BRAN model reported throughout. The native heads cleared the one-sided Bonferroni bound of the five-comparator family only against VisionFM with clinical values and age (+0.0114). The eye lowered referral net benefit at a risk threshold of 0.10 (−0.0143 [−0.0304, −0.0003], fold 0 deployed model, the prespecified estimand), so the development referral gain did not replicate. For haemoglobin the five-fold ensemble met its criterion, while the deployed fold 0 model, a prespecified sensitivity analysis, did not (−0.0343 [−0.0755, +0.0055] g/dL). The predecessor model had decoded these people's blood counts and ten condition source fields, so the test is a previously accessed paired check. MIMIC-IV, at least 30,040 survivors with 4,240 deaths within 365 days, replication not met. INSPIRE test split at least 17,660 survivors and 80 deaths, interval adjusted for two comparisons. HiRID counts are withheld by the source. Below 12 g/dL in HiRID the local fit-set median had lower error than the state ridge (1.208 against 1.280 g/dL, no paired test). KNHANES R² rows are replication variance beyond age and sex (at least 3,340, 3,280, 1,300 and 3,640 people). Red-cell axis in NHANES 2009 to 2018, at least 17,600 adults and 1,940 deaths, beside 19 raw labs 0.966 [0.798, 1.169]. Phenotypic Age acceleration alone 1.333 [1.259, 1.412]. Distance from health, at least 15,900 adults and 1,220 deaths. NHANES grip, at least 1,480 adults aged 65 to 79. KNHANES 2024, 5,600 adults aged 19 to 79, label efficiency at 250 labels +0.000 [−0.003, +0.004], not met. R8 also changed the native combined macro by −0.0089. Canonical pairs 2 to 5 failed the stability gate and were not tested against death. The predecessor eye arm contrast was +0.015 [+0.006, +0.023], Holm P 0.006, and the blood arm contrast +0.047 [−0.009, +0.102], from 2,000 patient-cluster bootstrap draws.
